views.name: ndbt_geography_record_counts
views.definition:
SELECT record_type,
    zone_id,
    zone_name,
    state_id,
    state_name,
    lga_id,
    lga_name,
    administrative_level,
    count(*) AS record_count,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE latitude IS NOT NULL AND longitude IS NOT NULL) AS coordinates_present
   FROM ndbt_record_geography
  GROUP BY record_type, zone_id, zone_name, state_id, state_name, lga_id, lga_name, administrative_level;

views.name: ndbt_record_geography
views.definition:
WITH records AS (
         SELECT 'individual'::text AS record_type,
            dbt_register_individuals.internal_record_id,
            dbt_register_individuals.record_status,
            dbt_register_individuals.country_code,
            dbt_register_individuals.geo_lowest_level_value_id,
            dbt_register_individuals.latitude,
            dbt_register_individuals.longitude,
            dbt_register_individuals.geo_code_hierarchy_json
           FROM dbt_register_individuals
        UNION ALL
         SELECT 'household'::text AS record_type,
            dbt_register_households.internal_record_id,
            dbt_register_households.record_status,
            dbt_register_households.country_code,
            dbt_register_households.geo_lowest_level_value_id,
            dbt_register_households.latitude,
            dbt_register_households.longitude,
            dbt_register_households.geo_code_hierarchy_json
           FROM dbt_register_households
        )
 SELECT r.record_type,
    r.internal_record_id,
    r.record_status,
    r.country_code,
    a.zone_id,
    a.zone_name,
    a.state_id,
    a.state_name,
        CASE
            WHEN a.area_level = 'lga'::text THEN a.area_id
            ELSE NULL::text
        END AS lga_id,
        CASE
            WHEN a.area_level = 'lga'::text THEN a.area_name
            ELSE NULL::text
        END AS lga_name,
    (r.geo_code_hierarchy_json -> 'karnatakadbt'::text) ->> 'ward'::text AS ward,
    COALESCE(a.area_level, 'unknown'::text) AS administrative_level,
        CASE
            WHEN r.latitude >= '-90'::integer::double precision AND r.latitude <= 90::double precision AND r.longitude >= '-180'::integer::double precision AND r.longitude <= 180::double precision THEN r.latitude
            ELSE NULL::double precision
        END AS latitude,
        CASE
            WHEN r.latitude >= '-90'::integer::double precision AND r.latitude <= 90::double precision AND r.longitude >= '-180'::integer::double precision AND r.longitude <= 180::double precision THEN r.longitude
            ELSE NULL::double precision
        END AS longitude,
    COALESCE((r.geo_code_hierarchy_json -> 'karnatakadbt'::text) ->> 'coordinate_source'::text, 'registry_unverified'::text) AS coordinate_source,
    false AS coordinate_verified,
    'KarnatakaDBT project identifiers, not official P-codes'::text AS code_system
   FROM records r
     LEFT JOIN ndbt_geography_areas a ON a.area_id = r.geo_lowest_level_value_id::text AND (r.country_code::text = ANY (ARRAY['IND'::character varying, 'IN'::character varying]::text[]));

views.name: dbt_age_distribution_view
views.definition:
SELECT company_id,
    jsonb_build_object('below_18', count(id) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(year FROM age(birthdate::timestamp with time zone)) < 18::numeric), '18_to_30', count(id) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(year FROM age(birthdate::timestamp with time zone)) >= 18::numeric AND EXTRACT(year FROM age(birthdate::timestamp with time zone)) <= 30::numeric), '31_to_40', count(id) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(year FROM age(birthdate::timestamp with time zone)) >= 31::numeric AND EXTRACT(year FROM age(birthdate::timestamp with time zone)) <= 40::numeric), '41_to_50', count(id) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(year FROM age(birthdate::timestamp with time zone)) >= 41::numeric AND EXTRACT(year FROM age(birthdate::timestamp with time zone)) <= 50::numeric), 'above_50', count(id) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(year FROM age(birthdate::timestamp with time zone)) > 50::numeric)) AS age_distribution
   FROM res_partner rp
  WHERE is_registrant = true AND active = true AND is_group = false
  GROUP BY company_id;

views.name: dbt_gender_count_view
views.definition:
SELECT rp.company_id,
    gt.code AS gender,
    count(rp.id) AS gender_count
   FROM res_partner rp
     LEFT JOIN gender_type gt ON rp.gender::text = gt.value::text
  WHERE rp.is_registrant = true AND rp.active = true AND rp.is_group = false
  GROUP BY rp.company_id, gt.code;

views.name: dbt_sr_dashboard_data
views.definition:
SELECT trv.company_id,
    trv.total_registrants,
    COALESCE(jsonb_object_agg(gc.gender, gc.gender_count) FILTER (WHERE gc.gender IS NOT NULL), '{}'::jsonb) AS gender_spec,
    adv.age_distribution
   FROM dbt_total_registrants_view trv
     LEFT JOIN dbt_gender_count_view gc ON trv.company_id = gc.company_id
     LEFT JOIN dbt_age_distribution_view adv ON trv.company_id = adv.company_id
  GROUP BY trv.company_id, trv.total_registrants, adv.age_distribution;

views.name: dbt_total_registrants_view
views.definition:
SELECT company_id,
    jsonb_build_object('total_individuals', count(id) FILTER (WHERE is_group = false), 'total_groups', count(id) FILTER (WHERE is_group = true)) AS total_registrants
   FROM res_partner rp
  WHERE is_registrant = true AND active = true
  GROUP BY company_id;

views.name: account_root
views.definition:
SELECT DISTINCT ascii(account_account.code::text) * 1000 + ascii("substring"(account_account.code::text, 2, 1)) AS id,
    "left"(account_account.code::text, 2) AS name,
    ascii(account_account.code::text) AS parent_id,
    account_account.company_id
   FROM account_account
  WHERE account_account.code::text <> ''::text
UNION ALL
 SELECT DISTINCT ascii(account_account.code::text) AS id,
    "left"(account_account.code::text, 1) AS name,
    NULL::integer AS parent_id,
    account_account.company_id
   FROM account_account
  WHERE account_account.code::text <> ''::text;

views.name: dbt_program_fund_report_view
views.definition:
WITH trans AS (
         SELECT a1.name,
            NULL::integer AS partner_id,
            a1.company_id,
            a1.program_id,
            NULL::integer AS cycle_id,
            a1.journal_id,
            a1.date_posted,
            a1.amount,
            a1.currency_id
           FROM dbt_program_fund a1
          WHERE a1.state::text = 'posted'::text
        UNION ALL
         SELECT b1.code AS name,
            b1.partner_id,
            b1.company_id,
            b3.id AS program_id,
            b2.id AS cycle_id,
            b1.journal_id,
            b5.date AS date_posted,
            b4.amount * '-1'::integer::numeric AS amount,
            b4.currency_id
           FROM dbt_entitlement b1
             LEFT JOIN dbt_cycle b2 ON b2.id = b1.cycle_id
             LEFT JOIN dbt_program b3 ON b3.id = b2.program_id
             LEFT JOIN account_payment b4 ON b4.id = b1.disbursement_id
             LEFT JOIN account_move b5 ON b5.id = b4.move_id
          WHERE b1.disbursement_id IS NOT NULL AND b4.payment_type::text = 'outbound'::text
        )
 SELECT row_number() OVER (ORDER BY date_posted) AS id,
    name,
    partner_id,
    company_id,
    program_id,
    cycle_id,
    journal_id,
    date_posted,
    amount,
    currency_id
   FROM trans
  ORDER BY date_posted;
